is there a nearby PUSH 71 (6A 47)?\n        ctx = data[max(0, i-30):i+30]\n        \n        # Check if 6A 47 is nearby\n        has_push_71 = b'\\x6a\\x47' in ctx\n        has_push_4 = b'\\x6a\\x04' in ctx\n        \n        # Look for MOV EAX to ALFRED offset\n        alfred_offset = None\n        for j in range(max(0, i-50), min(len(data)-5, i+30)):\n            if data[j] == 0xB8:\n                val = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", data[j+1:j+5])[0]\n                if 0x100000 &lt;= val &lt;= 0x400000:\n                    alfred_offset = val\n                    break\n        \n        print(f\"\\nPUSH 101 at file 0x{i:05X} (mem 0x{mem_addr:05X})\")\n        print(f\"  Has PUSH 71 nearby: {has_push_71}\")\n        print(f\"  Has PUSH 4 nearby: {has_push_4}\")\n        if alfred_offset:\n            print(f\"  ALFRED offset: 0x{alfred_offset:06X}\")\n        print(f\"  Context: {data[i:i+20].hex()}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"Searching for 4-frame animations with height around 100...\")\n\n# Find all calls to play_fight_animation and extract parameters\ncall_target = 0x26420\n\nfor i in range(0x14200, len(data) -   "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze combo table at 0x48118 to find brick+window handler\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\n# Combo table at 0x48118\n# 8-byte entries: item1 (2), item2 (2), function_ptr (4)\n\ntable_addr = 0x48118\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_addr)\n\nprint(\"Combo Table at 0x48118\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(f\"{'Index':&lt;6} {'Item1':&lt;10} {'Item2':&lt;10} {'Handler':&lt;12} Notes\")\nprint(\"-\" * 70)\n\n# Read until we hit 0xFFFF\nidx = 0\nbrick_combos = []\nwhile True:\n    off = table_file + idx * 8\n    if off + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    item1 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off:off+2])[0]\n    item2 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off+2:off+4])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", data[off+4:off+8])[0]\n    \n    if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"[{idx:3d}] END OF TABLE\")\n        break\n    \n    notes = \"\"\n    # Item 4 = brick\n    if item1 == 4 or item2 == 4:\n        notes = \"*** BRICK ***\"\n        brick_combos.append((idx, item1, item2, handler))\n    # Hotspot 294 = window\n    if item1 == 294 or item2 == 294:\n        notes = \"*** WINDOW (294) ***\"\n        brick_combos.append((idx, item1, item2, handler))\n    \n    print(f\"[{idx:3d}] {item1:&lt;10} {item2:&lt;10} 0x{handler:08X}  {notes}\")\n    \n    idx += 1\n    if idx &gt; 200:  # Safety limit\n        print(\"... (truncated)\")\n        break\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Brick-related combos:\")\nfor i, item1, item2, handler in brick_combos:\n    print(f\"  [{i}] Item1={item1}, Item2={item2}, Handler=0x{handler:08X}\")\n    \n    # Try to decompile the handler\n    handler_file = mem_to_file(handler) if handler &gt;= 0x10000 else handler\n    if 0x14200 &lt;= handler_file &lt; len(data) - 50:\n        print(f\"       Code at 0x{handler_file:05X}: {data[handler_file:handler_file+20].hex()}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze hotspot action table at 0x47bf0 to find window (294) handler\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\n# Hotspot action table at 0x47bf0\n# 6-byte entries: hotspot_id (2), function_ptr (4)\n\ntable_addr = 0x47bf0\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_addr)\n\nprint(\"Hotspot Action Table at 0x47BF0\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(f\"{'Index':&lt;6} {'Hotspot':&lt;10} {'Handler':&lt;12} Notes\")\nprint(\"-\" * 70)\n\nwindow_handler = None\nidx = 0\nwhile True:\n    off = table_file + idx * 6\n    if off + 6 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    hotspot = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off:off+2])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", data[off+2:off+6])[0]\n    \n    if hotspot == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"[{idx:3d}] END OF TABLE\")\n        break\n    \n    notes = \"\"\n    if hotspot == 294:\n        notes = \"*** WINDOW ***\"\n        window_handler = handler\n    \n    if 0x10000 &lt;= handler &lt;= 0x30000:\n        print(f\"[{idx:3d}] {hotspot:&lt;10} 0x{handler:08X}  {notes}\")\n    else:\n        if notes:\n            print(f\"[{idx:3d}] {hotspot:&lt;10} 0x{handler:08X}  {notes} (invalid?)\")\n    \n    idx += 1\n    if idx &gt; 500:\n        print(\"... (truncated)\")\n        break\n\nif window_handler:\n    print()\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"Window (294) handler at 0x{window_handler:08X}\")\n    handler_file = mem_to_file(window_handler)\n    if 0x14200 &lt;= handler_file &lt; len(data) - 100:\n        print(f\"Code at file offset 0x{handler_file:05X}:\")\n        print(f\"  First 50 bytes: {data[handler_file:handler_file+50].hex()}\")\n        \n        # Look for animation-related instructions\n        code = data[handler_file:handler_file+300]\n        for i in range(len(code) - 5):\n            if code[i] == 0xB8:  # MOV EAX, imm32\n                val = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", code[i+1:i+5])[0]\n                if 0x100000 &lt;= val &lt;= 0x400000:\n                    print(f\"  MOV EAX, 0x{val:06X} at offset +{i}\")\n            if code[i] == 0xE8:  # CALL\n                rel = struct.unpack(\"&lt;i\", code[i+1:i+5])[0]\n                target = window_handler + i + 5 + rel\n                if 0x10000 &lt;= target &lt;= 0x30000:\n                    print(f\"  CALL 0x{target:05X} at offset +{i}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze hotspot action table at 0x47bf0 - find window (294)\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\n# Hotspot action table at 0x47bf0\ntable_addr = 0x47bf0\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_addr)\n\nprint(f\"Table at mem 0x{table_addr:X}, file offset 0x{table_file:X}\")\nprint(f\"File size: {len(data)}\")\n\n# Read first few entries raw\nprint(\"\\nFirst 20 entries raw:\")\nfor i in range(20):\n    off = table_file + i * 6\n    if off + 6 &lt;= len(data):\n        entry = data[off:off+6]\n        hotspot = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", entry[0:2])[0]\n        handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", entry[2:6])[0]\n        print(f\"  [{i:3d}] 0x{off:05X}: {entry.hex()} -&gt; hotspot={hotspot}, handler=0x{handler:08X}\")\n\n# Search entire table for hotspot 294\nprint(\"\\nSearching for hotspot 294...\")\nfor i in range(500):\n    off = table_file + i * 6\n    if off + 6 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    hotspot = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off:off+2])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", data[off+2:off+6])[0]\n    \n    if hotspot == 294:\n        print(f\"  FOUND at index {i}: handler=0x{handler:08X}\")\n    if hotspot == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"  Table ends at index {i}\")\n        break\n\n# Also search for 294 as bytes anywhere in the table\nprint(\"\\nSearching for 0x0126 (294) as bytes near table...\")\nfor i in range(table_file - 50, table_file + 3000, 2):\n    if data[i:i+2] == b'\\x26\\x01':\n        ctx = data[i:i+10]\n        print(f\"  Found 294 at file 0x{i:05X}: {ctx.hex()}\")\n",

4):\n    if data[i:i+4] == b'BUDA':\n        buda_offsets.append(i)\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(buda_offsets)} BUDA markers\")\n\n# For each BUDA, try to find animation header before it\n# Try various potential frame sizes around 71 x 100\ntarget_widths = range(65, 80)  # 65-79\ntarget_heights = range(90, 110)  # 90-109\n\nprint(\"\\nSearching for 3-frame animations that end at BUDA markers...\")\nprint(\"(Looking for width 65-79, height 90-109)\\n\")\n\ncandidates = []\n\nfor buda_off in buda_offsets:\n    # Try different frame sizes\n    for w in target_widths:\n        for h in target_heights:\n            frame_size = w * h\n            # For 3 frames, uncompressed size would be 3 * w * h\n            # But it's RLE compressed, so actual size varies\n            \n            # Check if there could be animation data before this BUDA\n            # Look for reasonable starting points\n            for start_off in range(max(0, buda_off - 30000), buda_off - 100):\n                # Check if this could be start of animation\n                # Some animations have a small header\n                \n                # Try to decompress from this point\n                # Quick heuristic: look for patterns that suggest RLE data\n                pass  # Too slow to do full decompress\n\n# Alternative: look for animation offsets we know about and check nearby\nprint(\"Known ALFRED.7 animation offsets from play_fight_animation:\")\nknown_offsets = [\n    (0x2207FA, 71, 102, 11, \"fight animation\"),\n    (0x2D5B98, 51, 102, 4, \"shirt off\"),\n    (0x1F7274, 116, 124, 23, \"unknown\"),\n    (0x204830, 124, 18, 0, \"unknown\"),  # 0 frames - weird\n    (0x17C03C, 0, 107, 14, \"unknown\"),   # 0 width - weird\n    (0x186DBC, 102, 7, 2, \"unknown\"),\n    (0x1AB1DC, 95, 99, 13, \"unknown\"),\n    (0x2E5CF6, 71, 66, 14, \"unknown\"),  # w=71!\n    (0x182A56, 113, 103, 12, \"unknown\"),\n    (0x1ADFD2, 33, 72, 11, \"unknown\"),\n    (0x1B02D4, 115, 16, 2, \"unknown\"),\n]\n\nfor off, w, h, frames, desc in known_offsets:\n    print(f\"  0x{off:06X}: {w}x{h}, {frames} frames - {desc}\")\n\n# The offset 0x2E5CF6 has width 71! Let's look at nearby offsets\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Searching near known 71-width animation (0x2E5CF6)...\")\n\nbase = 0x2E5CF6\nfor delta in range(-0x10000, 0x10000, 0x1000):\n    test_off = base + delta\n    if 0 &lt;= test_off &lt; len(data) - 100:\n        # Check first few bytes\n        chunk = data[test_off:test_off+20]\n        # Look for potential RLE patterns\n        has_rle_pattern = False\n        for j in range(0, 16, 2):\n            count = chunk[j] if j &lt; len(chunk) else 0\n            if 1 &lt;= count &lt;= 200:  # Reasonable RLE count\n                has_rle_pattern = True\n        if has_rle_pattern:\n            print(f\"  0x{test_off:06X}: {chunk[:20].hex()}\")\n\n# Let's also look at the offset table in ALFRED.7 if there is one\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Checking ALFRED.7 header for offset table...\")\nheader = data[:256]\nprint(f\"First 64 bytes: {header[:64].hex()}\")\n\n# Read potential offsets from start\nprint(\"\\nFirst 20 potential 32-bit offsets:\")\nfor i in range(20):\n    off = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", data[i*4:(i+1)*4])[0]\n    if 0x1000 &lt;= off &lt;= len(data):\n        print(f\"  [{i:2d}] 0x{off:06X}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Better analysis of the item-use table\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\n# Raw data at 0x47111:\n# 0x47111: ffff 0000 0000 0000  &lt;- terminator then zeros\n# 0x47119: 1901 0200 b227 0100  &lt;- first real entry?\n# 0x47121: 2601 0400 4b28 0100  &lt;- 294, 4, handler 0x1284B\n# 0x47129: 2701 0400 f72a 0100  &lt;- 295, 4, handler 0x12AF7\n\n# The entries look like 8 bytes: hotspot(2), item(2), handler(4)\n# But the handlers look like they're 24-bit with a 01 00 suffix?\n\n# Let's try: hotspot(2), item(2), handler(2), room?(2)\nprint(\"Parsing as: hotspot(2), item(2), handler(2), room(2)\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Start after the 0xFFFF terminator\ntable_start = 0x47119\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_start)\n\nfor i in range(50):\n    off = table_file + i * 8\n    if off + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    hotspot = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off:off+2])[0]\n    item = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off+2:off+4])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off+4:off+6])[0]\n    room = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[off+6:off+8])[0]\n    \n    if hotspot == 0:\n        continue\n    if hotspot == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"[{i:2d}] END OF TABLE\")\n        break\n    \n    notes = \"\"\n    if hotspot == 294:\n        notes = \" *** WINDOW ***\"\n    if item == 4:\n        notes += \" *** BRICK ***\"\n    \n    # Handler could be offset into code, add 0x10000\n    full_handler = handler + 0x10000\n    \n    print(f\"[{i:2d}] hotspot={hotspot:5d}, item={item:3d}, handler=0x{full_handler:05X}, room={room}{notes}\")\n\n# Now let's look at the brick+window handler at 0x1284B (0x284B + 0x10000)\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Decompiling brick+window handler at 0x1284B:\")\n\nhandler_addr = 0x1284B\nhandler_file = mem_to_file(handler_addr)\n\nprint(f\"File offset: 0x{handler_file:05X}\")\nif handler_file &lt; len(data) - 300:\n    code = data[handler_file:handler_file+300]\n    print(f\"First 50 bytes: {code[:50].hex()}\")\n    \n    # Look for patterns\n    print(\"\\nKey instructions:\")\n    for j in range(min(200, len(code) - 5)):\n        byte = code[j]\n        if byte == 0xB8:  # MOV EAX, imm32\n            val = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", code[j+1:j+5])[0]\n            if 0x100000 &lt;= val &lt;= 0x400000:\n                print(f\"  +{j:3d}: MOV EAX, 0x{val:06X} (ALFRED.7 offset)\")\n            elif 0x10000 &lt;= val &lt;= 0x60000:\n                print(f\"  +{j:3d}: MOV EAX, 0x{val:05X} (memory address)\")\n        elif byte == 0xE8:  # CALL rel32\n            rel = struct.unpack(\"&lt;i\", code[j+1:j+5])[0]\n            target = handler_addr + j + 5 + rel\n            if 0x10000 &lt;= target &lt;= 0x50000:\n                print(f\"  +{j:3d}: CALL 0x{target:05X}\")\n        elif byte == 0x6A:  # PUSH imm8\n            val = code[j+1]\n            print(f\"  +{j:3d}: PUSH 0x{val:02X} ({val})\")\n        elif byte == 0xC3:  # RET\n            print(f\"  +{j:3d}: RET\")\n            break\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for code that references hotspot 294 (0x126) or item 4\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\nprint(\"Searching for CMP with 294 (0x126) in code...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# CMP r/m16, 294 could be: 66 81 F9 26 01 (CMP CX, 0x126)\n# or 66 83 ?? 26 01 etc\n# or CMP word ptr [mem], 0x126\n\n# Search for 0x26 0x01 (294 LE) in code section\ncode_start = 0x14200\ncode_end = min(len(data), 0x3E000)  # Approximate code end\n\nfound = []\nfor i in range(code_start, code_end - 10):\n    # Look for immediate 294 (0x0126)\n    if data[i:i+2] == b'\\x26\\x01':\n        # Check if this looks like an immediate in a CMP or MOV instruction\n        # Context\n        ctx_start = max(code_start, i - 10)\n        ctx = data[ctx_start:i+10]\n        \n        # Check for instruction prefixes/opcodes before\n        prev_bytes = data[max(code_start, i-4):i]\n        \n        # CMP imm16 patterns\n        # 66 81 F9 26 01 = CMP CX, 0x126\n        # 66 81 FB 26 01 = CMP BX, 0x126\n        # 66 3D 26 01 = CMP AX, 0x126\n        \n        is_cmp = False\n        if len(prev_bytes) &gt;= 2:\n            if prev_bytes[-2:] == b'\\x66\\x3d':  # CMP AX, imm16\n                is_cmp = True\n            if prev_bytes[-1] == 0x3d:  # CMP EAX, imm32\n                if data[i+2:i+4] == b'\\x00\\x00':  # High bytes are 0\n                    is_cmp = True\n        if len(prev_bytes) &gt;= 3:\n            if prev_bytes[-3:-1] == b'\\x66\\x81':  # CMP r16, imm16\n                is_cmp = True\n            if prev_bytes[-2:-1] == b'\\x81':  # CMP r32/m32, imm32\n                is_cmp = True\n\n        mem = i - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n        \n        # Only show if in reasonable code area and looks like comparison\n        if 0x10000 &lt;= mem &lt;= 0x30000:\n            if is_cmp:\n                print(f\"  CMP with 294 at mem 0x{mem:05X}: {ctx.hex()}\")\n                found.append(mem)\n            elif i not in [f + 2 for f in found]:  # Avoid duplicates\n                # Show all occurrences of 294 in code\n                print(f\"  Value 294 at mem 0x{mem:05X}: ...{prev_bytes.hex()} [2601] {data[i+2:i+6].hex()}\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nTotal found: {len(found)} comparison instructions\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Now searching for any animation call with 3 frames...\")\n\n# PUSH 3 = 6A 03\n# Look for 6A 03 followed by CALL within 30 bytes\nfor i in range(code_start, code_end - 40):\n    if data[i] == 0x6A and data[i+1] == 0x03:\n        # Look for CALL play_fight_animation (E8 rel32 where target = 0x26420)\n        for j in range(i, min(i+40, code_end-5)):\n            if data[j] == 0xE8:\n                rel = struct.unpack(\"&lt;i\", data[j+1:j+5])[0]\n                target = (j - 0x14200 + 0x10000) + 5 + rel\n                if target == 0x26420:\n                    mem = i - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n                    print(f\"  PUSH 3 at 0x{mem:05X} with CALL play_fight_animation at 0x{j - 0x14200 + 0x10000:05X}\")\n",

}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Properly parse the combo table at 0x48118\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\n# Combo table at 0x48118\n# 8-byte entries: item1(2), item2(2), handler(4)\n# Used when using an inventory item on a hotspot\n\ntable_addr = 0x48118\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_addr)\n\nprint(f\"Combo Table at 0x48118 (file offset 0x{table_file:05X})\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\nprint(f\"{'Idx':&lt;4} {'Item1':&lt;8} {'Item2':&lt;8} {'Handler':&lt;12} {'Raw':&lt;20} Notes\")\nprint(\"-\" * 80)\n\nfor i in range(200):\n    off = table_file + i * 8\n    if off + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    raw = data[off:off+8]\n    item1 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[0:2])[0]\n    item2 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[2:4])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", raw[4:8])[0]\n    \n    if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"[{i:3d}] END OF TABLE (0xFFFF)\")\n        break\n    \n    # Skip zero entries\n    if item1 == 0 and item2 == 0 and handler == 0:\n        continue\n    \n    notes = \"\"\n    # Item 4 = brick\n    if item1 == 4 or item2 == 4:\n        notes = \"*** BRICK ***\"\n    # Hotspot 294 = window\n    if item1 == 294 or item2 == 294:\n        notes += \" *** WINDOW ***\"\n    \n    # Check if handler is a valid code address\n    handler_valid = \"\"\n    if 0x10000 &lt;= handler &lt;= 0x30000:\n        handler_valid = \"(valid code addr)\"\n    elif handler &lt; 0x1000:\n        handler_valid = \"(likely offset)\"\n    \n    print(f\"[{i:3d}] {item1:&lt;8} {item2:&lt;8} 0x{handler:08X} {raw.hex():&lt;20} {notes} {handler_valid}\")\n\n# Look for brick (4) or window (294) manually\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"Searching entire file for potential brick(4)+window(294) combo entries...\")\n\n# Look for the pattern: 04 00 26 01 or 26 01 04 00\nfor i in range(len(data) - 8):\n    chunk = data[i:i+8]\n    \n    # Check for item1=4, item2=294: 04 00 26 01\n    if chunk[0:4] == b'\\x04\\x00\\x26\\x01':\n        handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", chunk[4:8])[0]\n        mem = i - 0x14200 + 0x10000 if i &gt;= 0x14200 else i\n        print(f\"  Found brick(4)+window(294) at 0x{i:05X} (mem ~0x{mem:05X}): handler=0x{handler:08X}\")\n    \n    # Check for item1=294, item2=4: 26 01 04 00\n    if chunk[0:4] == b'\\x26\\x01\\x04\\x00':\n        handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", chunk[4:8])[0]\n        mem = i - 0x14200 + 0x10000 if i &gt;= 0x14200 else i\n        print(f\"  Found window(294)+brick(4) at 0x{i:05X} (mem ~0x{mem:05X}): handler=0x{handler:08X}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze the item-hotspot table at 0x47111\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\ndef mem_to_file(mem_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (mem_addr - 0x10000)\n\n# Found at 0x47120: window(294)+brick(4) with handler 0x0001284B\n# The table appears to be at 0x47111, starting after 0xFFFF terminator\n\n# Let's check what's before 0x47111 to understand the table structure\nstart_mem = 0x47100\nstart_file = mem_to_file(start_mem)\n\nprint(\"Raw data around 0x47100:\")\nfor i in range(0, 0x100, 16):\n    off = start_file + i\n    line = data[off:off+16]\n    mem = start_mem + i\n    print(f\"0x{mem:05X}: {line.hex()}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\n\n# The table at 0x47111 seems to have 8-byte entries after the 0xFFFF\n# Structure: hotspot(2), item(2), handler(4)?\n\n# Let's parse starting at 0x47119 (after the 0xFFFF 00 00 00 00 00 00)\ntable_start = 0x47119\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_start)\n\nprint(f\"Parsing table at 0x47119 as 8-byte entries:\")\nprint(\"-\" * 80)\n\nfor i in range(40):\n    off = table_file + i * 8\n    if off + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    raw = data[off:off+8]\n    \n    # Try: hotspot(2), item(2), handler(4)\n    hotspot = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[0:2])[0]\n    item = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[2:4])[0]\n    handler = struct.unpack(\"&lt;I\", raw[4:8])[0]\n    \n    notes = \"\"\n    if hotspot == 294:\n        notes = \"*** WINDOW ***\"\n    if item == 4:\n        notes += \" *** BRICK ***\"\n    if hotspot == 0 and item == 0:\n        if handler == 0:\n            continue\n    \n    # Verify handler\n    handler_info = \"\"\n    if 0x10000 &lt;= handler &lt;= 0x30000:\n        handler_info = \"valid code\"\n    elif handler == 0:\n        handler_info = \"null\"\n    \n    print(f\"[{i:2d}] hotspot={hotspot:5d}, item={item:3d}, handler=0x{handler:08X} ({handler_info}) {notes}\")\n    print(f\"     Raw: {raw.hex()}\")\n\n# Look at the brick+window handler at 0x1284B\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"Analyzing brick+window handler at 0x1284B:\")\n\nhandler_addr = 0x1284B\nhandler_file = mem_to_file(handler_addr)\n\nprint(f\"File offset: 0x{handler_file:05X}\")\n\n# This is actually show_action_menu_popup according to Ghidra\n# But wait - 0x1284B is mid-function! Let me check the actual bytes\n\ncode = data[handler_file:handler_file+50]\nprint(f\"Bytes at handler: {code.hex()}\")\n\n# The handler pointer 0x1284B seems wrong\n# Let's check what function 0x1284B is in\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"Checking if 0x1284B is inside show_action_menu_popup (0x124AD)...\")\n\n# show_action_menu_popup starts at 0x124AD\nfunc_start = 0x124AD\nfunc_file = mem_to_file(func_start)\nprint(f\"show_action_menu_popup at 0x124AD, file offset 0x{func_file:05X}\")\nprint(f\"Handler 0x1284B is {0x1284B - 0x124AD} bytes into the function\")\n\n# This suggests the handler pointer is WRONG in the table\n# It's pointing to the middle of show_action_menu_popup!\n# This might be a bug in the game data or I'm parsing the table wrong.\n\n# Let me try parsing differently - maybe it's not 8-byte entries\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\nprint(\"Trying alternative parsing: 6-byte entries (hotspot, item, handler as 16-bit)\")\n\ntable_start = 0x47119\ntable_file = mem_to_file(table_start)\n\nfor i in range(50):\n    off = table_file + i * 6\n    if off + 6 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    \n    raw = data[off:off+6]\n    hotspot = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[0:2])[0]\n    item = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[2:4])[0]\n    handler16 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", raw[4:6])[0]\n    \n    if hotspot == 0 and item == 0:\n        continue\n    \n    notes = \"\"\n    if hotspot == 294:\n        notes = \"*** WINDOW ***\"\n    if item == 4:\n        notes += \" *** BRICK ***\"\n    \n    # Handler as base + offset\n    handler = 0x10000 + handler16\n    \n    print(f\"[{i:2d}] hotspot={hotspot:5d}, item={item:3d}, handler=0x{handler:05X} {notes}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Brute force search ALFRED.7 for 3-frame animations\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, max_output=50000):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data until BUDA marker or max output\"\"\"\n    output = []\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) - 1 and len(output) &lt; max_output:\n        count = data[i]\n        value = data[i + 1]\n        \n        # Check for BUDA marker\n        if i + 3 &lt; len(data) and data[i:i+4] == b'BUDA':\n            return bytes(output), True\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            # End or special case\n            i += 2\n            continue\n        \n        output.extend([value] * count)\n        i += 2\n    \n    return bytes(output), False\n\nwith open(\"files/ALFRED.7\", \"rb\") as f:\n    alfred7 = f.read()\n\nprint(\"Searching ALFRED.7 for 3-frame animations around 71 pixels wide...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Target dimensions\ntarget_widths = range(65, 80)  # 65-79\ntarget_heights = range(90, 115)  # 90-114\nframe_count = 3\n\ncandidates = []\n\n# Search for potential animation data\n# Strategy: Try decompressing at various offsets and check if output size matches 3 * w * h\nfor offset in range(0, len(alfred7) - 1000, 0x100):\n    # Try to decompress\n    chunk = alfred7[offset:offset + 20000]\n    if len(chunk) &lt; 100:\n        continue\n    \n    decompressed, found_buda = decompress_rle(chunk)\n    \n    if not found_buda or len(decompressed) &lt; 1000:\n        continue\n    \n    size = len(decompressed)\n    \n    # Check if size matches any 3-frame animation\n    for w in target_widths:\n        for h in target_heights:\n            expected = w * h * 3\n            if size == expected:\n                candidates.append((offset, w, h, size))\n                print(f\"  0x{offset:06X}: {w}x{h}x3 = {expected} bytes\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nFound {len(candidates)} potential 3-frame animations\")\n\n# Also check the known animation offsets\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Checking known animation offsets for nearby 3-frame data...\")\n\nknown_offsets = [\n    0x2207FA,  # 71x102, 11 frames\n    0x2E5CF6,  # 71x66, 14 frames\n]\n\nfor base in known_offsets:\n    print(f\"\\nSearching around 0x{base:06X}:\")\n    # Try offsets before and after\n    for delta in range(-0x5000, 0x5000, 0x100):\n        test_off = base + delta\n        if test_off &lt;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Extract and preview 3-frame animation candidates\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, max_output=100000):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data until BUDA marker or max output\"\"\"\n    output = []\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) - 1 and len(output) &lt; max_output:\n        # Check for BUDA marker\n        if i + 3 &lt; len(data) and data[i:i+4] == b'BUDA':\n            return bytes(output), i\n        \n        count = data[i]\n        value = data[i + 1]\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            i += 2\n            continue\n        \n        output.extend([value] * count)\n        i += 2\n    \n    return bytes(output), -1\n\nwith open(\"files/ALFRED.7\", \"rb\") as f:\n    alfred7 = f.read()\n\n# Load palette from room 7 (or room 0)\n# For now, use grayscale\ndef save_ppm(data, width, height, filename):\n    with open(filename, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(f\"P5\\n{width} {height}\\n255\\n\".encode())\n        # Data is palette indices, just output as grayscale for preview\n        f.write(data)\n\nos.makedirs(\"output_3frame\", exist_ok=True)\n\n# Candidates near 71x101\ncandidates = [\n    (0x01D800, 72, 101, \"brick_throw_candidate1\"),\n    (0x02BC00, 72, 101, \"brick_throw_candidate2\"),\n    (0x2A5600, 70, 102, \"brick_throw_candidate3\"),\n    (0x308900, 73, 101, \"brick_throw_candidate4\"),\n]\n\nfor offset, width, height, name in candidates:\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"Extracting {name} at 0x{offset:06X} ({width}x{height}x3)\")\n    \n    chunk = alfred7[offset:offset + 30000]\n    decompressed, buda_pos = decompress_rle(chunk)\n    \n    print(f\"  Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)} bytes\")\n    print(f\"  Expected size: {width * height * 3} bytes\")\n    print(f\"  BUDA at compressed offset: +0x{buda_pos:04X}\" if buda_pos &gt;= 0 else \"  No BUDA found\")\n    \n    expected = width * height * 3\n    if len(decompressed) &gt;= expected:\n        frame_size = width * height\n        for frame in range(3):\n            frame_start = frame * frame_size\n            frame_data = decompressed[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n            \n            filename = f\"output_3frame/{name}_frame{frame}.ppm\"\n            save_ppm(frame_data, width, height, filename)\n            print(f\"  Saved frame {frame}: {filename}\")\n            \n            # Show some stats about the frame\n            unique_vals = set(frame_data)\n            transparent_count = frame_data.count(0xFF)\n            print(f\"    Unique palette indices: {len(unique_vals)}\")\n            print(f\"    Transparent pixels (0xFF): {transparent_count} ({100*transparent_count/frame_size:.1f}%)\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"  ERROR: Not enough data!\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*60)\nprint(\"Done! Check output_3frame/ directory for PPM files\")\n",

1 and len(output) &lt; max_output:\n        if i + 3 &lt; len(data) and data[i:i+4] == b'BUDA':\n            return bytes(output), i\n        \n        count = data[i]\n        value = data[i + 1]\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            i += 2\n            continue\n        \n        output.extend([value] * count)\n        i += 2\n    \n    return bytes(output), -1\n\nwith open(\"files/ALFRED.7\", \"rb\") as f:\n    alfred7 = f.read()\n\nos.makedirs(\"output_brick_throw\", exist_ok=True)\n\ndef save_ppm(data, width, height, filename):\n    with open(filename, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(f\"P5\\n{width} {height}\\n255\\n\".encode())\n        f.write(data[:width*height])\n\n# The animation we found: 0x1AF3EA, 72x99, 3 frames\nanim_offset = 0x1AF3EA\nwidth = 72\nheight = 99\nframes = 3\n\nprint(f\"Extracting animation at 0x{anim_offset:06X}\")\nprint(f\"Dimensions: {width}x{height}, {frames} frames\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\n\nchunk = alfred7[anim_offset:anim_offset + 30000]\ndecompressed, buda_pos = decompress_rle(chunk)\n\nprint(f\"Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)} bytes\")\nprint(f\"Expected size: {width * height * frames} bytes\")\nprint(f\"BUDA at compressed offset: +0x{buda_pos:04X}\")\n\nframe_size = width * height\n\nfor frame in range(frames):\n    frame_start = frame * frame_size\n    frame_data = decompressed[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n    \n    filename = f\"output_brick_throw/frame_{frame}.ppm\"\n    save_ppm(frame_data, width, height, filename)\n    \n    # Stats\n    unique = len(set(frame_data))\n    trans = frame_data.count(0xFF)\n    non_trans = frame_size - trans\n    \n    print(f\"\\nFrame {frame}:\")\n    print(f\"  File: {filename}\")\n    print(f\"  Unique colors: {unique}\")\n    print(f\"  Transparent (0xFF): {trans} ({100*trans/frame_size:.1f}%)\")\n    print(f\"  Non-transparent: {non_trans} pixels\")\n    \n    # Show color histogram\n    from collections import Counter\n    colors = Counter(frame_data)\n    top_colors = colors.most_common(10)\n    print(f\"  Top 10 colors: {top_colors}\")\n\n# Also save raw binary for inspection\nwith open(\"output_brick_throw/all_frames.bin\", \"wb\") as f:\n    f.write(decompressed[:frame_size * frames])\nprint(f\"\\nSaved raw data to output_brick_throw/all_frames.bin\")\n\n# Now search for more 3-frame animations with high transparency (sprites)\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"Searching for all 3-frame sprites (high transparency)...\")\n\nbuda_offsets = []\nfor i in range(len(alfred7) - 4):\n    if alfred7[i:i+4] == b'BUDA':\n        buda_offsets.append(i)\n\nsprite_candidates = []\n\nfor buda_off in buda_offsets:\n    anim_start = buda_off + 4\n    chunk = alfred7[anim_start:anim_start + 30000]\n    if len(chunk) &lt; 100:\n        continue\n    \n    decompressed, end_pos = decompress_rle(chunk)\n    if end_pos &lt; 0 or len(decompressed) &lt; 5000:\n        continue\n    \n    size = len(decompressed)\n    \n    # Check for 3-frame animations with width 65-80, height 95-110\n    for w in range(65, 81):\n        for h in range(95, 111):\n            expected = w * h * 3\n            if size == expected:\n                # Check transparency\n                frame_size = w * h\n                trans = decompressed[:frame_size].count(0xFF)\n                trans_pct = 100 * trans / frame_size\n                \n                # Sprite should have significant transparency (&gt;30%)\n                if trans_pct &gt; 30:\n                    sprite_candidates.append((anim_start, w, h, trans_pct))\n                    print(f\"  0x{anim_start:06X}: {w}x{h}x3, {trans_pct:.1f}% transparent\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nFound {len(sprite_candidates)} potential 3-frame sprites\")\n\n# Extract all sprite candidates\nfor offset, w, h, trans_pct in sprite_candidates:\n    chunk = alfred7[offset:offset + 30000]\n    decompressed, _ = decompress_rle(chunk)\n    frame_size = w * h\n    \n    for frame in range(3):\n        frame_data = decompressed[frame * frame_size:(frame + 1) * frame_size]\n        filename = f\"output_brick_throw/sprite_{offset:06X}_{w}x{h}_f{frame}.ppm\"\n        save_ppm(frame_data, w, h, filename)\n    \n    print(f\"  Extracted: sprite_{offset:06X}_{w}x{h}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Decompress room 3 data blocks and look for 3-frame animations\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, max_output=500000):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data until BUDA marker\"\"\"\n    output = []\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) - 1 and len(output) &lt; max_output:\n        if i + 3 &lt; len(data) and data[i:i+4] == b'BUDA':\n            return bytes(output), True\n        \n        count = data[i]\n        value = data[i + 1]\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            i += 2\n            continue\n        \n        output.extend([value] * count)\n        i += 2\n    \n    return bytes(output), False\n\nos.makedirs(\"output_room3_decompressed\", exist_ok=True)\n\n# Read the extracted room 3 data blocks\npairs = [\n    (\"pair00_background.bin\", \"background\"),\n    (\"pair01_sprites_chars.bin\", \"sprites\"),\n    (\"pair02_unknown2.bin\", \"unknown2\"),\n    (\"pair03_unknown3.bin\", \"unknown3\"),\n    (\"pair04_unknown4.bin\", \"unknown4\"),\n    (\"pair05_unknown5.bin\", \"unknown5\"),\n    (\"pair06_unknown6.bin\", \"unknown6\"),\n    (\"pair07_unknown7.bin\", \"unknown7\"),\n    (\"pair08_unknown8.bin\", \"unknown8\"),\n]\n\nprint(\"Decompressing room 3 data blocks...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nfor filename, name in pairs:\n    filepath = f\"output_room3/{filename}\"\n    if not os.path.exists(filepath):\n        continue\n    \n    with open(filepath, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    decompressed, found_buda = decompress_rle(data)\n    \n    print(f\"\\n{name} ({filename}):\")\n    print(f\"  Compressed: {len(data)} bytes\")\n    print(f\"  Decompressed: {len(decompressed)} bytes\")\n    print(f\"  BUDA found: {found_buda}\")\n    \n    # Save decompressed data\n    out_file = f\"output_room3_decompressed/{name}.bin\"\n    with open(out_file, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(decompressed)\n    \n    size = len(decompressed)\n    \n    # Check if this could be a 320x200 background or part of it\n    if size == 64000:\n        print(f\"  ** 320x200 full screen! **\")\n    elif size == 32000:\n        print(f\"  ** 320x100 half screen! **\")\n    \n    # Check for 3-frame animation sizes (width 65-85, height 95-115)\n    for w in range(50, 100):\n        for h in range(80, 130):\n            if size == w * h * 3:\n                print(f\"  ** Could be {w}x{h}x3 animation! **\")\n            elif size == w * h * 4:\n                print(f\"  ** Could be {w}x{h}x4 animation! **\")\n            elif size == w * h:\n                print(f\"  ** Could be {w}x{h} single frame! **\")\n    \n    # Check transparency\n    if len(decompressed) &gt; 0:\n        trans = decompressed.count(0xFF)\n        trans_pct = 100 * trans / len(decompressed)\n        if trans_pct &gt; 30:\n            print(f\"  High transparency: {trans_pct:.1f}% (likely sprite)\")\n        \n        unique = len(set(decompressed))\n        print(f\"  Unique colors: {unique}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"\\nNow let's check if room 3 has the throwing animation nearby...\")\n\n# The window is in room 3. Let's look at the sprites data more carefully\nwith open(\"output_room3/pair01_sprites_chars.bin\", \"rb\") as f:\n    sprites_data = f.read()\n\nprint(f\"\\nSprites data (pair 1) analysis:\")\nprint(f\"  Total compressed size: {len(sprites_data)} bytes\")\n\n# Try decompressing just the first part\ndecompressed, _ = decompress_rle(sprites_data)\nprint(f\"  Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)} bytes\")\n\n# Save as PPM to visualize (try different widths)\ndef save_ppm(data, width, height, filename):\n    with open(filename, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(f\"P5\\n{width} {height}\\n255\\n\".encode())\n        f.write(data[:width*height])\n\n# Try common sprite widths\nfor w in [64, 72, 80, 96, 128]:\n    h = len(decompressed) // w\n    if h &gt; 0 and h &lt; 500:\n        filename = f\"output_room3_decompressed/sprites_w{w}.ppm\"\n        save_ppm(decompressed, w, h, filename)\n        print(f\"  Saved as {w}x{h}: {filename}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for animation headers in room 3 pair 8 decompressed data\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef decompress_rle(data):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data (count-value pairs)\"\"\"\n    result = bytearray()\n    pos = 0\n    while pos + 1 &lt; len(data):\n        count = data[pos]\n        value = data[pos + 1]\n        if count == 0:\n            break\n        result.extend([value] * count)\n        pos += 2\n    return bytes(result)\n\n# Load room 3 pair 8\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Room 3 pair 8 at 0x000DBA6C, size 64162 bytes\n    f.seek(0x000DBA6C)\n    raw = f.read(64162)\n\ndecompressed = decompress_rle(raw)\nprint(f\"Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)} bytes\")\n\n# Look for potential animation headers\n# Format might be: width (word), height (word), frames (word or byte)\nprint(\"\\nSearching for animation header patterns...\")\nprint(\"Looking for width ~71 and height ~99-101:\")\n\nfor offset in range(0, len(decompressed) - 10):\n    # Try word-based header\n    w = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', decompressed, offset)[0]\n    h = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', decompressed, offset + 2)[0]\n    \n    if 65 &lt;= w &lt;= 80 and 90 &lt;= h &lt;= 110:\n        # Could be an animation header\n        next_bytes = decompressed[offset:offset+16]\n        print(f\"  Offset 0x{offset:06X}: width={w}, height={h}, next bytes: {next_bytes.hex()}\")\n\n# Also look for recognizable patterns in the first 1KB\nprint(\"\\n\\nFirst 256 bytes (hex):\")\nfor i in range(0, 256, 32):\n    print(f\"  0x{i:04X}: {decompressed[i:i+32].hex()}\")\n\n# Look at the boundaries identified earlier\nboundaries = [39059, 52126, 169423, 182596, 195648, 208767]\nprint(\"\\n\\nData around sprite boundaries:\")\nfor b in boundaries:\n    before = decompressed[b-8:b]\n    at = decompressed[b:b+8]\n    print(f\"  Offset 0x{b:06X}: before={before.hex()}, after={at.hex()}\")\n\n# Look for 3 sequential 0xFF runs that could be 3 frames\nprint(\"\\n\\nLooking for 3 sequential similar-sized transparent regions...\")\nruns = []\nin_run = False\nrun_start = 0\nfor i, b in enumerate(decompressed):\n    if b == 0xFF:\n        if not in_run:\n            run_start = i\n            in_run = True\n    else:\n        if in_run:\n            run_len = i - run_start\n            if run_len &gt; 50:  # Significant run\n                runs.append((run_start, run_len))\n            in_run = False\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(runs)} significant 0xFF runs\")\n# Group by similar sizes\nfor i in range(len(runs) - 2):\n    r1, r2, r3 = runs[i:i+3]\n    len1, len2, len3 = r1[1], r2[1], r3[1]\n    # Similar sizes (within 10%)\n    avg = (len1 + len2 + len3) / 3\n    if all(abs(l - avg) &lt; avg * 0.15 for l in [len1, len2, len3]):\n        gap1 = r2[0] - (r1[0] + r1[1])\n        gap2 = r3[0] - (r2[0] + r2[1])\n        if 6000 &lt; gap1 &lt; 8000 and 6000 &lt; gap2 &lt; 8000:  # ~71*99 = 7029\n            print(f\"  Potential 3-frame sequence:\")\n            print(f\"    Run 1: offset=0x{r1[0]:06X}, len={len1}\")\n            print(f\"    Run 2: offset=0x{r2[0]:06X}, len={len2}, gap from prev={gap1}\")\n            print(f\"    Run 3: offset=0x{r3[0]:06X}, len={len3}, gap from prev={gap2}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze room 3 pair 1 (sprites/chars) in detail\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef decompress_rle(data):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data (count-value pairs)\"\"\"\n    result = bytearray()\n    pos = 0\n    while pos + 1 &lt; len(data):\n        count = data[pos]\n        value = data[pos + 1]\n        if count == 0:\n            break\n        result.extend([value] * count)\n        pos += 2\n    return bytes(result)\n\ndef save_ppm(filename, width, height, data, palette=None):\n    \"\"\"Save as PPM with palette\"\"\"\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filename) if os.path.dirname(filename) else '.', exist_ok=True)\n    with open(filename, 'wb') as f:\n        f.write(f'P6\\n{width} {height}\\n255\\n'.encode())\n        for b in data:\n            if palette:\n                r, g, b_color = palette[b]\n                f.write(bytes([r, g, b_color]))\n            else:\n                # Greyscale with transparent as magenta\n                if b == 0xFF:\n                    f.write(bytes([255, 0, 255]))  # Magenta\n                else:\n                    f.write(bytes([b, b, b]))\n\n# Load palette from room 3\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Room 3 directory at offset for room 3\n    f.seek(3 * 26)  # 13 pairs * 2 bytes each = 26 per room\n    directory = f.read(26)\n    pairs = []\n    for i in range(13):\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', directory, i*4)[0] if i*2+4 &lt;= len(directory) else 0\n        # Hmm, the format is different...\n\n# Let me read from the room start properly\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # ALFRED.1 header: 56 rooms, each with 13 (offset, size) pairs\n    # Each entry is 8 bytes (4 byte offset + 4 byte size) = 104 bytes per room\n    # Actually it might be just (offset, size) pairs = 4+4 = 8 bytes each, 13 pairs = 104 bytes\n    \n    # Room 3 index starts at 3 * 104 = 312\n    f.seek(3 * (13 * 8))\n    room3_dir = f.read(13 * 8)\n    \n    print(\"Room 3 data pairs from ALFRED.1:\")\n    for i in range(13):\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8)[0]\n        size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8 + 4)[0]\n        print(f\"  Pair {i:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size={size}\")\n\n# Looks like the previous script worked differently. Let me use those values\n# From previous output: Room 3 Pair 1: 0x000B58AE, size 24806 bytes\n\npair1_offset = 0x000B58AE\npair1_size = 24806\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(pair1_offset)\n    pair1_raw = f.read(pair1_size)\n\n# Check for BUDA marker\nbuda_pos = pair1_raw.find(b'BUDA')\nprint(f\"\\nPair 1 BUDA marker at offset 0x{buda_pos:04X}\" if buda_pos &gt;= 0 else \"No BUDA marker\")\n\n# Decompress\npair1_decompressed = decompress_rle(pair1_raw)\nprint(f\"Pair 1 decompressed: {len(pair1_decompressed)} bytes\")\n\n# Analyze transparency\ntrans = sum(1 for b in pair1_decompressed if b == 0xFF)\nprint(f\"Transparency: {100*trans/len(pair1_decompressed):.1f}%\")\nprint(f\"Unique colors: {len(set(pair1_decompressed))}\")\n\n# Factor for potential animation dimensions\nprint(f\"\\nFactorization of {len(pair1_decompressed)}:\")\nsize = len(pair1_decompressed)\nfor f in range(2, min(200, size)):\n    if size % f == 0:\n        other = size // f\n        if 2 &lt;= other &lt;= 1000:\n            print(f\"  {f} x {other}\")\n\n# Look for width 71 dimensions\nprint(\"\\n3-frame animation check (width ~71):\")\nfor w in range(65, 80):\n    frame_size = size // 3\n    if size % 3 == 0 and frame_size % w == 0:\n        h = frame_size // w\n        print(f\"  {w} x {h} x 3 frames\")\n\n# Also look at first 256 bytes\nprint(\"\\nFirst 256 bytes:\")\nfor i in range(0, 256, 32):\n    print(f\"  0x{i:04X}: {pair1_decompressed[i:i+32].hex()}\")\n\n# Save full image at various widths\nos.makedirs('output_room3_pair1', exist_ok=True)\nfor w in [71, 72, 73, 100, 120, 160]:\n    h = len(pair1_decompressed) // w\n    if h &gt; 0:\n        data = pair1_decompressed[:w*h]\n        save_ppm(f'output_room3_pair1/full_w{w}.ppm', w, h, data)\n        print(f\"Saved: output_room3_pair1/full_w{w}.ppm ({w}x{h})\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "# DOSBox-X Debugging Strategies for Alfred Pelrock Animation Analysis\n\n## Quick Reference: Finding the Brick Throwing Animation\n\n### Goal\nLocate the 3-frame animation (~71 pixels wide) used when Alfred throws the brick at the window in room 3.\n\n### Method 1: Break on File Read During Brick Action\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Start DOSBox-X with debugger\ndosbox-x -debug\n\n# Inside DOSBox, run the game and go to room 3\n# Save your game state before the brick action\n\n# Enable debugger (Alt+Pause)\n# Set breakpoint on DOS file read (INT 21h, AH=3Fh)\nBPINT 21 3F\n\n# Return to game (F5) and use brick on window\n# When breakpoint hits, check DS:DX for buffer address\n# and CX for read size\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Method 2: Memory Snapshot Comparison\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# In debugger before brick action:\nMEMDUMPBIN 0 FFFFF before.bin\n\n# Perform the brick animation\n\n# After animation:\nMEMDUMPBIN 0 FFFFF after.bin\n\n# Then compare externally:\nxxd before.bin &gt; before.hex\nxxd after.bin &gt; after.hex\ndiff before.hex after.hex | head -100\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Method 3: Trace play_fight_animation Calls\n\nThe &#96;play_fight_animation&#96; function is at real-mode address &#96;seg:26420&#96;.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# In DOSBox-X debugger:\n# First find the game's code segment\n# Then set breakpoint at play_fight_animation\nBP seg:26420\n\n# When it breaks, examine stack for parameters:\n# - Frame count\n# - Width\n# - Height\n# - Animation data pointer\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Method 4: Break on Animation Display (VGA BLIT)\n\nAnimation frames are eventually copied to VGA memory at A000:0000.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Set memory write breakpoint on VGA segment\n# This is more advanced - look for writes to A000:0000-A000:FFFF\n# during the brick animation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Key Addresses to Monitor\n\n| Address | Description |\n|---------|-------------|\n| 0x26420 | play_fight_animation function |\n| 0x191E9 | execute_complex_item_script_table |\n| 0x47120 | Item combo table (brick+window entry) |\n| 0x48118 | ALFRED.7 book table |\n\n## ALFRED.1 Room 3 Structure\n\nRoom 3 data pairs:\n- **Pair 0**: Background image (26896 bytes compressed)\n- **Pair 1**: Sprites/chars (24806 bytes → 31670 decompressed, 4.3% transparent)\n- **Pair 8**: Unknown data (64162 bytes → 235876 decompressed, 71% transparent)\n- **Pair 11**: Palette (768 bytes - 256 RGB triplets)\n\n## Animation Data Sources\n\n1. **ALFRED.2**: Character talking animations (RLE compressed)\n2. **ALFRED.3**: Character movement animations\n3. **ALFRED.7**: Misc sprites and cursors (has BUDA markers)\n4. **Room data (ALFRED.1)**: Room-specific sprites in pairs 0, 1, 8\n\n## Search Strategy\n\nThe brick animation might be:\n1. In ALFRED.7 (general sprites file) - Already searched, found candidate at 0x1AF3EA\n2. Embedded in room 3's data pairs - Currently analyzing\n3. Loaded dynamically based on item combo handler\n\n## DOSBox-X Debugger Commands Reference\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Breakpoints\nBP seg:offset       # Code breakpoint\nBPM addr            # Memory read/write breakpoint  \nBPINT num func      # Interrupt breakpoint\n\n# Memory\nMEMDUMPBIN addr len file  # Dump memory to file\nD seg:offset              # Display memory\nC seg:off seg:off len     # Compare memory\n\n# Execution\nG                   # Go (continue)\nF5                  # Continue\nT                   # Trace (step)\nP                   # Procedure step (step over calls)\n\n# Information\nR                   # Show registers\nSR                  # Show segment registers\nLOG C               # Log all CALL instructions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Alternative: Static Analysis Approach\n\nIf DOSBox-X tracing is complex, try:\n\n1. Search JUEGO.EXE for references to the brick+window combo entry\n2. Find the handler that loads/plays the animation\n3. Trace which file and offset it reads from\n\nKey code to find: The corrupted handler at 0x1284B might have nearby valid handlers that show the pattern.\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Parse room 3 sprite data structure to find animation parameters\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\n# Room 3 directory from ALFRED.1 (from extract_room3_data.py output)\n# Pair 0: background, offset 0x000B3078, size 26896\n# Pair 1: sprites/chars, offset 0x000B58AE, size 24806\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    # Read room directory at start of file\n    # 56 rooms, 13 pairs each, each pair is offset (4) + size (4) = 8 bytes\n    # So room N starts at N * 13 * 8 = N * 104 bytes\n    \n    # Room 3 directory\n    f.seek(3 * 13 * 8)\n    room3_dir = f.read(13 * 8)\n    \n    print(\"Room 3 Data Pairs:\")\n    pairs = []\n    for i in range(13):\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8)[0]\n        size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8 + 4)[0]\n        print(f\"  Pair {i:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size={size}\")\n        pairs.append((offset, size))\n\n# Read pair 0 (background + sprites header)\nbg_offset, bg_size = pairs[0]\nprint(f\"\\n\\nReading pair 0 (background/sprites) at 0x{bg_offset:08X}...\")\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(bg_offset)\n    pair0 = f.read(bg_size)\n\n# The sprite data starts after the background image header\n# Let's look at the beginning of the data\nprint(\"\\nFirst 256 bytes of pair 0:\")\nfor i in range(0, 256, 32):\n    print(f\"  0x{i:04X}: {pair0[i:i+32].hex()}\")\n\n# Look for sprite count at offset +5\nsprite_count = pair0[5]\nprint(f\"\\nSprite count at +5: {sprite_count}\")\n\n# Each sprite structure is 0x2C (44) bytes\n# Let's dump each sprite's info\nSPRITE_SIZE = 0x2C\nprint(f\"\\nSprite structures ({SPRITE_SIZE} bytes each):\")\n\nfor sprite_idx in range(min(sprite_count + 1, 20)):  # Limit to avoid reading garbage\n    offset = 6 + sprite_idx * SPRITE_SIZE  # Skip first 6 bytes (header)\n    if offset + SPRITE_SIZE &gt; len(pair0):\n        break\n    \n    sprite = pair0[offset:offset + SPRITE_SIZE]\n    \n    # Parse sprite structure based on Ghidra comments\n    # +0x06: Pointer to graphic data (4 bytes, but probably offset)\n    # +0x0A: X coord (2 bytes)\n    # +0x0C: Y coord (2 bytes)\n    # +0x0E: Width (1 byte)\n    # +0x0F: Height (1 byte)\n    # +0x10: Stride (2 bytes)\n    # +0x12: Num sequences (1 byte)\n    # +0x13: Current sequence (1 byte)\n    # +0x14-0x17: Frame counts per sequence (4 bytes)\n    # +0x21: Z-depth (1 byte, 0xFF = disabled)\n    \n    gfx_ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', sprite, 0x00)[0]  # First 4 bytes might be graphic offset\n    x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0A - 0x06)[0] if len(sprite) &gt; 0x0A - 0x06 + 2 else 0\n    y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0C - 0x06)[0] if len(sprite) &gt; 0x0C - 0x06 + 2 else 0\n    \n    # Actually the structure starts at sprite_data_ptr + sprite_id * 0x2C\n    # So offset 0x06 in Ghidra is relative to sprite structure start + 6\n    # Let me re-read the raw bytes\n    \n    print(f\"\\n  Sprite {sprite_idx}:\")\n    print(f\"    Raw bytes: {sprite.hex()}\")\n    \n    # Parse based on actual structure\n    if len(sprite) &gt;= 0x2C:\n        # Offsets are relative to sprite struct start\n        x_coord = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0A)[0]\n        y_coord = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0C)[0]\n        width = sprite[0x0E]\n        height = sprite[0x0F]\n        stride = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', sprite, 0x10)[0]\n        num_sequences = sprite[0x12]\n        cur_sequence = sprite[0x13]\n        frame_counts = sprite[0x14:0x18]\n        z_depth = sprite[0x21]\n        \n        print(f\"    X={x_coord}, Y={y_coord}, W={width}, H={height}\")\n        print(f\"    Stride={stride}, Sequences={num_sequences}, CurSeq={cur_sequence}\")\n        print(f\"    Frame counts per seq: {list(frame_counts)}\")\n        print(f\"    Z-depth: 0x{z_depth:02X} ({'disabled' if z_depth == 0xFF else 'enabled'})\")\n",

}

Read room directory at start of file\n    f.seek(3 * 13 * 8)  # Room 3 directory\n    room3_dir = f.read(13 * 8)\n    \n    pairs = []\n    for i in range(13):\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8)[0]\n        size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8 + 4)[0]\n        pairs.append((offset, size))\n\nprint(\"Room 3 Data Pairs (from directory):\")\nfor i, (offset, size) in enumerate(pairs):\n    print(f\"  Pair {i:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size={size}\")\n\n# Read pair 10 (room data: hotspots, walkboxes, exits, sprites)\npair10_offset, pair10_size = pairs[10]\nprint(f\"\\n\\nReading pair 10 (room data) at 0x{pair10_offset:08X}, size {pair10_size}...\")\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(pair10_offset)\n    pair10 = f.read(pair10_size)\n\n# First 16 bytes\nprint(\"\\nFirst 32 bytes of pair 10:\")\nprint(f\"  {pair10[:32].hex()}\")\n\n# Sprite count at offset 0x05\nsprite_count = pair10[5]\nprint(f\"\\nSprite count at +0x05: {sprite_count}\")\n\n# Sprite headers start at +0x06, each is 0x2C (44) bytes\nSPRITE_SIZE = 0x2C\nprint(f\"\\nSprite structures ({SPRITE_SIZE} bytes each):\")\n\nfor sprite_idx in range(sprite_count):\n    offset = 0x06 + sprite_idx * SPRITE_SIZE\n    if offset + SPRITE_SIZE &gt; len(pair10):\n        print(f\"  Sprite {sprite_idx}: Out of bounds!\")\n        break\n    \n    sprite = pair10[offset:offset + SPRITE_SIZE]\n    \n    # Parse sprite structure based on documentation:\n    # +0x00: X position (u16)\n    # +0x02: Y position (u16)\n    # +0x04: Width (u8)\n    # +0x05: Height (u8)\n    # +0x06: Extra (u8) - might be graphics offset or flags\n    # +0x0A: More data...\n    # +0x12: Num sequences (u8)\n    # +0x13: Current sequence (u8)\n    # +0x14-0x17: Frame counts per sequence (4 bytes)\n    # +0x21: Z-depth (1 byte, 0xFF = disabled)\n    \n    x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', sprite, 0x00)[0]\n    y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', sprite, 0x02)[0]\n    width = sprite[0x04]\n    height = sprite[0x05]\n    extra = sprite[0x06]\n    \n    # The update_npc_sprite_animations function uses these offsets:\n    # +0x06: Pointer to graphic data (4 bytes)\n    # +0x0A: X coord\n    # +0x0C: Y coord\n    # +0x0E: Width\n    # +0x0F: Height\n    # +0x10: Stride\n    # +0x12: Num sequences\n    # +0x13: Current sequence\n    # +0x14+seq: Frame counts per sequence\n    # +0x21: Z-depth\n    \n    # Let's try this alternate interpretation:\n    gfx_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', sprite, 0x06)[0]\n    x2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0A)[0]\n    y2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0C)[0]\n    w2 = sprite[0x0E]\n    h2 = sprite[0x0F]\n    stride = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', sprite, 0x10)[0]\n    num_seq = sprite[0x12]\n    cur_seq = sprite[0x13]\n    frame_counts = list(sprite[0x14:0x18])\n    z_depth = sprite[0x21]\n    \n    print(f\"\\n  Sprite {sprite_idx}:\")\n    print(f\"    Raw first 16: {sprite[:16].hex()}\")\n    print(f\"    X/Y (doc): {x},{y}  W/H (doc): {width}x{height}\")\n    print(f\"    GfxOffset: 0x{gfx_offset:08X}\")\n    print(f\"    X/Y (code): {x2},{y2}  W/H (code): {w2}x{h2}\")\n    print(f\"    Stride: {stride}, Sequences: {num_seq}\")\n    print(f\"    Frame counts: {frame_counts}\")\n    print(f\"    Z-depth: 0x{z_depth:02X}\")\n    \n    # Check if this could be the brick animation (~71x? with 3 frames)\n    if 65 &lt;= w2 &lt;= 80:\n        print(f\"    *** POTENTIAL MATCH: width {w2} is close to target 71 ***\")\n    if frame_counts[0] == 3 or frame_counts[1] == 3:\n        print(f\"    *** POTENTIAL MATCH: has 3-frame sequence ***\")\n",

len(data):\n        count = data[pos]\n        value = data[pos + 1]\n        if count == 0:\n            break\n        result.extend([value] * count)\n        pos += 2\n    return bytes(result)\n\ndef save_ppm(filename, width, height, data):\n    \"\"\"Save as PPM with magenta for transparent pixels\"\"\"\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filename) if os.path.dirname(filename) else '.', exist_ok=True)\n    with open(filename, 'wb') as f:\n        f.write(f'P6\\n{width} {height}\\n255\\n'.encode())\n        for b in data:\n            if b == 0xFF:\n                f.write(bytes([255, 0, 255]))  # Magenta\n            else:\n                f.write(bytes([b, b, b]))  # Grayscale\n\n# Read room 3 directory\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(3 * 13 * 8)\n    room3_dir = f.read(13 * 8)\n    \n    pairs = []\n    for i in range(13):\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8)[0]\n        size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8 + 4)[0]\n        pairs.append((offset, size))\n\n# Read pair 8 (sprite pixel data)\npair8_offset, pair8_size = pairs[8]\nprint(f\"Pair 8 (sprite pixels): offset=0x{pair8_offset:08X}, size={pair8_size}\")\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(pair8_offset)\n    pair8_raw = f.read(pair8_size)\n\n# Check if it's RLE compressed (look at first byte of pair 10)\npair10_offset, pair10_size = pairs[10]\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(pair10_offset)\n    pair10 = f.read(pair10_size)\n\n# First byte indicates if pair 8 needs decompression\nneeds_decompress = pair10[0] == 0\nprint(f\"First byte of pair 10: 0x{pair10[0]:02X} -&gt; {'COMPRESSED' if needs_decompress else 'RAW'}\")\n\nif needs_decompress:\n    pair8_pixels = decompress_rle(pair8_raw)\nelse:\n    pair8_pixels = pair8_raw\n\nprint(f\"Pair 8 decompressed: {len(pair8_pixels)} bytes\")\n\n# Now parse sprite metadata from pair 10\nsprite_count = pair10[5]\nprint(f\"\\nSprite count: {sprite_count}\")\n\n# Extract each sprite's frames\nSPRITE_SIZE = 0x2C\nos.makedirs('output_room3_sprites', exist_ok=True)\n\npixel_offset = 0\nfor sprite_idx in range(2, sprite_count):  # Skip sprites 0 and 1 (system)\n    struct_offset = sprite_idx * SPRITE_SIZE\n    if struct_offset + SPRITE_SIZE &gt; len(pair10):\n        break\n    \n    sprite = pair10[struct_offset:struct_offset + SPRITE_SIZE]\n    \n    # Parse sprite structure:\n    # +0x0E: Width (after +6 header adjustment)\n    # +0x0F: Height\n    # +0x10: Stride (bytes per row) \n    # +0x12: Num sequences\n    # +0x14+seq: Frame count per sequence\n    \n    # Actually the structure in Ghidra shows:\n    # +0x0A: X coord\n    # +0x0C: Y coord\n    # +0x0E: Width\n    # +0x0F: Height\n    # +0x10: Stride (2 bytes)\n    # +0x12: Num sequences (1 byte)\n    # +0x14+seq: Frame count per sequence\n    \n    x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0A)[0]\n    y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;h', sprite, 0x0C)[0]\n    width = sprite[0x0E]\n    height = sprite[0x0F]\n    stride = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', sprite, 0x10)[0]\n    num_sequences = sprite[0x12]\n    \n    # Calculate total frames\n    total_frames = 0\n    for seq in range(min(num_sequences, 4)):\n        frames_in_seq = sprite[0x14 + seq]\n        total_frames += frames_in_seq\n    \n    if width == 0 or height == 0 or stride == 0:\n        print(f\"  Sprite {sprite_idx}: Invalid dimensions (W={width}, H={height}, Stride={stride})\")\n        continue\n    \n    frame_size = stride * height\n    \n    print(f\"\\n  Sprite {sprite_idx}: X={x}, Y={y}, W={width}, H={height}, Stride={stride}\")\n    print(f\"    Sequences={num_sequences}, Total frames={total_frames}\")\n    print(f\"    Pixel offset: 0x{pixel_offset:06X}, Frame size: {frame_size}\")\n    \n    # Check if this could be the brick animation (~71 wide, 3 frames)\n    if 65 &lt;= width &lt;= 80:\n        print(f\"    *** POTENTIAL WIDTH MATCH: {width} close to target 71 ***\")\n    \n    # Extract frames\n    for frame in range(min(total_frames, 10)):  # Limit frames\n        start = pixel_offset + frame * frame_size\n        end = start + frame_size\n        \n        if end &gt; len(pair8_pixels):\n            print(f\"    Frame {frame}: Out of bounds (need {end}, have {len(pair8_pixels)})\")\n            break\n        \n        frame_data = pair8_pixels[start:end]\n        \n        # Check transparency\n        trans = sum(1 for b in frame_data if b == 0xFF)\n        trans_pct = 100 * trans / len(frame_data) if len(frame_data) &gt; 0 else 0\n        \n        if trans_pct &lt; 95:  # Only save non-empty frames\n            filename = f'output_room3_sprites/sprite{sprite_idx}_frame{frame}_{width}x{height}.ppm'\n            save_ppm(filename, stride, height, frame_data)\n            print(f\"    Frame {frame}: {trans_pct:.1f}% transparent -&gt; {filename}\")\n    \n    # Advance pixel offset for next sprite\n    pixel_offset += frame_size * total_frames\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Extract room 3 sprites using width as stride\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef decompress_rle(data):\n    \"\"\"Decompress RLE data (count-value pairs)\"\"\"\n    result = bytearray()\n    pos = 0\n    while pos + 1 &lt; len(data):\n        count = data[pos]\n        value = data[pos + 1]\n        if count == 0:\n            break\n        result.extend([value] * count)\n        pos += 2\n    return bytes(result)\n\ndef save_ppm(filename, width, height, data):\n    \"\"\"Save as PPM with magenta for transparent pixels\"\"\"\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filename) if os.path.dirname(filename) else '.', exist_ok=True)\n    with open(filename, 'wb') as f:\n        f.write(f'P6\\n{width} {height}\\n255\\n'.encode())\n        for b in data:\n            if b == 0xFF:\n                f.write(bytes([255, 0, 255]))  # Magenta\n            else:\n                f.write(bytes([b, b, b]))  # Grayscale\n\n# Read room 3 directory\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(3 * 13 * 8)\n    room3_dir = f.read(13 * 8)\n    \n    pairs = []\n    for i in range(13):\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8)[0]\n        size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room3_dir, i*8 + 4)[0]\n        pairs.append((offset, size))\n\n# Read pair 8 (sprite pixel data) and decompress\npair8_offset, pair8_size = pairs[8]\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(pair8_offset)\n    pair8_raw = f.read(pair8_size)\n\npair8_pixels = decompress_rle(pair8_raw)\nprint(f\"Pair 8 decompressed: {len(pair8_pixels)} bytes\")\n\n# Read pair 10 (sprite metadata)\npair10_offset, pair10_size = pairs[10]\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(pair10_offset)\n    pair10 = f.read(pair10_size)\n\nsprite_count = pair10[5]\nprint(f\"Sprite count: {sprite_count}\")\n\n# Manual sprite definitions based on pair 10 hex analysis\n# Sprite 6: +0x0E W=40, +0x0F H=48\n# Let's manually extract:\n\nos.makedirs('output_room3_sprites_v2', exist_ok=True)\n\n# Sprite info extracted from hex dump:\nsprites = [\n    # (sprite_idx, x, y, width, height, num_seq, frame_counts)\n    (2, 39, 329, 44, 51, 1, [1]),      # Sprite 2\n    (5, 530, 176, 55, 26, 1, [8]),     # Sprite 5\n    (6, 48, 85, 40, 48, 2, [3]),       # Sprite 6 - possible brick!\n    (7, 261, 275, 38, 31, 2, [3]),     # Sprite 7\n    (8, -122, 287, 122, 107, 1, [16]), # Sprite 8\n]\n\n# Calculate pixel offsets for each sprite\n# Game code iterates: for each sprite, for each sequence, calculate frame offset\n# Frame size = width * height (assuming stride = width)\n\n# Actually, let's just try extracting raw blocks at different widths\n# to see what looks like an animation\n\nprint(\"\\n\\nTrying to find brick animation in pair 8 pixels...\")\nprint(f\"Total pixels: {len(pair8_pixels)}\")\n\n# The brick animation is likely ~71 wide, 3 frames\n# Let's search for 3-frame animations around that size\nfor width in [40, 48, 55, 65, 70, 71, 72, 75, 80]:\n    for height in range(40, 120, 10):\n        frame_size = width * height\n        total_size = frame_size * 3\n        \n        if total_size &gt; len(pair8_pixels):\n            continue\n        \n        # Check if first 3 frames at various offsets have reasonable transparency\n        for start in range(0, len(pair8_pixels) - total_size, frame_size):\n            frames_valid = True\n            trans_pcts = []\n            for f in range(3):\n                frame_start = start + f * frame_size\n                frame_end = frame_start + frame_size\n                frame = pair8_pixels[frame_start:frame_end]\n                trans = sum(1 for b in frame if b == 0xFF)\n                trans_pct = 100 * trans / frame_size\n                trans_pcts.append(trans_pct)\n                \n                # Valid frame: 30-90% transparent, not all same\n                if not (30 &lt; trans_pct &lt; 90):\n                    frames_valid = False\n                    break\n            \n            if frames_valid and 65 &lt;= width &lt;= 80:\n                avg_trans = sum(trans_pcts) / 3\n                # All similar transparency\n                if max(trans_pcts) - min(trans_pcts) &lt; 20:\n                    print(f\"  Potential 3-frame anim at offset 0x{start:06X}: {width}x{height}, trans: {trans_pcts}\")\n                    \n                    # Save these frames\n                    for f in range(3):\n                        frame_start = start + f * frame_size\n                        frame_data = pair8_pixels[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n                        fname = f'output_room3_sprites_v2/candidate_{width}x{height}_off{start:06X}_f{f}.ppm'\n                        save_ppm(fname, width, height, frame_data)\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract the most promising brick animation candidates from room 3 pair 8.\nLooking for 3-frame animations around 72x100 or similar dimensions.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n# Room 3 directory in ALFRED.1\nROOM_DIR_OFFSET = 0x370  # Room 3 starts at offset 0x370 in directory\nALFRED1_PATH = \"files/ALFRED.1\"\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, expected_size):\n    \"\"\"Simple RLE decompression.\"\"\"\n    result = bytearray()\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) and len(result) &lt; expected_size:\n        byte = data[i]\n        i += 1\n        if byte &gt;= 0x80:\n            # Run of same byte\n            count = byte - 0x80 + 1\n            if i &lt; len(data):\n                value = data[i]\n                i += 1\n                result.extend([value] * count)\n        else:\n            # Literal bytes\n            count = byte + 1\n            result.extend(data[i:i+count])\n            i += count\n    return bytes(result[:expected_size])\n\ndef load_room_palette(room_num=3):\n    \"\"\"Load palette from pair 11.\"\"\"\n    with open(ALFRED1_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        # Read room directory\n        f.seek(room_num * 26)  # 13 pairs * 2 bytes each\n        pairs = []\n        for _ in range(13):\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', f.read(2))[0]\n            pairs.append(offset)\n        \n        # Pair 11 is palette - but we need to calculate actual offset\n        # The offsets are relative, need to find the base\n        # Let's just use a default VGA palette\n        pass\n    \n    # Default VGA palette\n    palette = []\n    for i in range(256):\n        palette.extend([i, i, i])  # Grayscale\n    return palette\n\ndef extract_candidates():\n    \"\"\"Extract promising brick animation candidates.\"\"\"\n    with open(ALFRED1_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        # Read room 3 directory (13 pairs at room_num * 26)\n        f.seek(3 * 26)\n        pairs = []\n        for i in range(13):\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n            print(f\"Pair {i}: offset=0x{offset:06X}, size={size}\")\n    \n        # Pair 8 is sprite pixel data\n        pair8_offset, pair8_size = pairs[8]\n        print(f\"\\nPair 8: offset=0x{pair8_offset:X}, size={pair8_size}\")\n        \n        f.seek(pair8_offset)\n        compressed = f.read(pair8_size)\n        \n        # Pair 11 is palette\n        pair11_offset, pair11_size = pairs[11]\n        f.seek(pair11_offset)\n        pal_data = f.read(pair11_size)\n    \n    # Decompress pair 8\n    # Try different decompression target sizes\n    print(f\"\\nCompressed size: {len(compressed)}\")\n    \n    # Build palette\n    palette = []\n    if len(pal_data) &gt;= 768:\n        for i in range(256):\n            r = pal_data[i*3] * 4\n            g = pal_data[i*3+1] * 4\n            b = pal_data[i*3+2] * 4\n            palette.extend([min(255,r), min(255,g), min(255,b)])\n    else:\n        for i in range(256):\n            palette.extend([i, i, i])\n    \n    # Decompress to large buffer\n    decompressed = decompress_rle(compressed, 300000)\n    print(f\"Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)}\")\n    \n    os.makedirs(\"output_brick_candidates\", exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Most promising candidates from search: 72x100\n    # Extract frames at offset 0x000000 with different dimensions\n    candidates = [\n        # (offset, width, height, description)\n        (0x0, 72, 100, \"72x100_start\"),\n        (0x1C20, 72, 100, \"72x100_1C20\"),\n        (0x0, 71, 102, \"71x102_start\"),  # Cheat animation dimensions\n        (0x0, 40, 48, \"40x48_sprite6\"),   # From pair 10 metadata\n        (0x0, 38, 31, \"38x31_sprite7\"),   # From pair 10 metadata\n    ]\n    \n    # Also try extracting based on the pair 10 sprite metadata\n    # Sprite 6 was at W=40, H=48 with 2 sequences\n    # Try to find contiguous 3-frame animations\n    \n    # Search for sequences that look like animation frames\n    # (consecutive frames should have similar transparency)\n    \n    for test_w in [40, 48, 71, 72, 80]:\n        for test_h in [40, 48, 50, 60, 100, 102]:\n            frame_size = test_w * test_h\n            if frame_size * 3 &gt; len(decompressed):\n                continue\n            \n            # Check first 3 frames at offset 0\n            frames = []\n            for i in range(3):\n                frame_start = i * frame_size\n                frame_data = decompressed[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n                trans_count = sum(1 for b in frame_data if b == 0)\n                trans_pct = 100.0 * trans_count / frame_size\n                frames.append((frame_data, trans_pct))\n            \n            # If all 3 frames have reasonable transparency (30-85%), extract\n            if all(30 &lt;= f[1] &lt;= 85 for f in frames):\n                desc = f\"{test_w}x{test_h}_off0\"\n                print(f\"Extracting {desc}: trans=[{frames[0][1]:.1f}, {frames[1][1]:.1f}, {frames[2][1]:.1f}]\")\n                \n                for i, (frame_data, _) in enumerate(frames):\n                    img = Image.new('P', (test_w, test_h))\n                    img.putpalette(palette)\n                    img.putdata(list(frame_data))\n                    img.save(f\"output_brick_candidates/{desc}_frame{i}.png\")\n    \n    # Also extract first N KB as raw dump to inspect\n    with open(\"output_brick_candidates/pair8_first_8k.bin\", \"wb\") as out:\n        out.write(decompressed[:8192])\n    \n    print(\"\\nDone! Check output_brick_candidates/\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    extract_candidates()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract brick animation candidates from room 3 pair 8.\nFixed version that correctly reads room directory.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nALFRED1_PATH = \"files/ALFRED.1\"\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, expected_size):\n    \"\"\"Simple RLE decompression.\"\"\"\n    result = bytearray()\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) and len(result) &lt; expected_size:\n        byte = data[i]\n        i += 1\n        if byte &gt;= 0x80:\n            count = byte - 0x80 + 1\n            if i &lt; len(data):\n                value = data[i]\n                i += 1\n                result.extend([value] * count)\n        else:\n            count = byte + 1\n            result.extend(data[i:i+count])\n            i += count\n    return bytes(result[:expected_size])\n\ndef main():\n    with open(ALFRED1_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        # Room directory: 56 rooms, each has 13 offset/size pairs (uint32 each)\n        # Room 3 starts at offset 3 * 13 * 8 = 312 = 0x138\n        room_dir_offset = 3 * 13 * 8\n        f.seek(room_dir_offset)\n        \n        pairs = []\n        print(\"Room 3 directory:\")\n        for i in range(13):\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n            if size &gt; 0:\n                print(f\"  Pair {i:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size={size:6d}\")\n        \n        # Pair 8 is sprite pixel data\n        pair8_offset, pair8_size = pairs[8]\n        print(f\"\\nPair 8 (sprites): offset=0x{pair8_offset:X}, size={pair8_size}\")\n        \n        f.seek(pair8_offset)\n        compressed = f.read(pair8_size)\n        \n        # Pair 11 is palette\n        pair11_offset, pair11_size = pairs[11]\n        f.seek(pair11_offset)\n        pal_data = f.read(pair11_size)\n        print(f\"Pair 11 (palette): offset=0x{pair11_offset:X}, size={pair11_size}\")\n    \n    # Decompress pair 8\n    print(f\"\\nCompressed size: {len(compressed)}\")\n    decompressed = decompress_rle(compressed, 400000)\n    print(f\"Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)}\")\n    \n    # Build palette\n    palette = []\n    if len(pal_data) &gt;= 768:\n        for i in range(256):\n            r = pal_data[i*3] * 4\n            g = pal_data[i*3+1] * 4\n            b = pal_data[i*3+2] * 4\n            palette.extend([min(255,r), min(255,g), min(255,b)])\n    else:\n        print(f\"Warning: palette too small ({len(pal_data)} bytes)\")\n        for i in range(256):\n            palette.extend([i, i, i])\n    \n    os.makedirs(\"output_brick_candidates\", exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Save raw decompressed data for analysis\n    with open(\"output_brick_candidates/pair8_decompressed.bin\", \"wb\") as out:\n        out.write(decompressed)\n    \n    # Try different dimensions to find 3-frame animations\n    print(\"\\nSearching for 3-frame animations with 30-85% transparency...\")\n    found = 0\n    \n    for test_w in [40, 48, 50, 60, 71, 72, 80]:\n        for test_h in [40, 48, 50, 60, 80, 100, 102, 110]:\n            frame_size = test_w * test_h\n            if frame_size * 3 &gt; len(decompressed):\n                continue\n            \n            # Check frames starting at offset 0\n            frames = []\n            for i in range(3):\n                frame_start = i * frame_size\n                frame_data = decompressed[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n                trans_count = sum(1 for b in frame_data if b == 0)\n                trans_pct = 100.0 * trans_count / frame_size\n                frames.append((frame_data, trans_pct))\n            \n            # If all 3 frames have reasonable transparency (30-85%), extract\n            if all(30 &lt;= f[1] &lt;= 85 for f in frames):\n                desc = f\"{test_w}x{test_h}\"\n                print(f\"  {desc}: trans=[{frames[0][1]:.1f}%, {frames[1][1]:.1f}%, {frames[2][1]:.1f}%]\")\n                \n                for i, (frame_data, _) in enumerate(frames):\n                    img = Image.new('P', (test_w, test_h))\n                    img.putpalette(palette)\n                    img.putdata(list(frame_data))\n                    img.save(f\"output_brick_candidates/{desc}_frame{i}.png\")\n                found += 1\n    \n    print(f\"\\nExtracted {found} candidate animation sets\")\n    print(\"Files saved to output_brick_candidates/\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
