  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch through entire decompressed room 3 pair 8 for brick animation.\nLooking for 3 consecutive frames with reasonable transparency.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nALFRED1_PATH = \"files/ALFRED.1\"\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, expected_size):\n    \"\"\"Simple RLE decompression.\"\"\"\n    result = bytearray()\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) and len(result) &lt; expected_size:\n        byte = data[i]\n        i += 1\n        if byte &gt;= 0x80:\n            count = byte - 0x80 + 1\n            if i &lt; len(data):\n                value = data[i]\n                i += 1\n                result.extend([value] * count)\n        else:\n            count = byte + 1\n            result.extend(data[i:i+count])\n            i += count\n    return bytes(result[:expected_size])\n\ndef main():\n    with open(ALFRED1_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        # Room 3 directory\n        room_dir_offset = 3 * 13 * 8\n        f.seek(room_dir_offset)\n        \n        pairs = []\n        for i in range(13):\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        \n        # Pair 8 is sprite pixel data\n        pair8_offset, pair8_size = pairs[8]\n        f.seek(pair8_offset)\n        compressed = f.read(pair8_size)\n        \n        # Pair 11 is palette\n        pair11_offset, pair11_size = pairs[11]\n        f.seek(pair11_offset)\n        pal_data = f.read(pair11_size)\n    \n    decompressed = decompress_rle(compressed, 400000)\n    print(f\"Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)}\")\n    \n    # Analyze transparency distribution\n    trans_count = sum(1 for b in decompressed if b == 0)\n    print(f\"Overall transparency: {100.0 * trans_count / len(decompressed):.1f}%\")\n    \n    # Build palette\n    palette = []\n    for i in range(256):\n        r = pal_data[i*3] * 4\n        g = pal_data[i*3+1] * 4\n        b = pal_data[i*3+2] * 4\n        palette.extend([min(255,r), min(255,g), min(255,b)])\n    \n    os.makedirs(\"output_brick_search\", exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Save the raw decompressed data\n    with open(\"output_brick_search/pair8_raw.bin\", \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(decompressed)\n    print(f\"Saved raw data to output_brick_search/pair8_raw.bin\")\n    \n    # Try to find where sprites start by looking for patterns\n    # Sprites often have runs of transparent (0) pixels\n    \n    # Search for 3-frame sequences at various offsets\n    print(\"\\nSearching for 3-frame animations...\")\n    \n    # Target: 71 wide (user estimate), try heights 40-120\n    candidates = []\n    \n    for width in [40, 48, 60, 70, 71, 72, 80]:\n        for height in [40, 48, 50, 60, 80, 100, 102]:\n            frame_size = width * height\n            max_offset = len(decompressed) - frame_size * 3\n            \n            # Check every 1000 bytes\n            for start in range(0, max_offset, 1000):\n                frames_trans = []\n                for i in range(3):\n                    frame_start = start + i * frame_size\n                    frame_data = decompressed[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n                    trans = sum(1 for b in frame_data if b == 0)\n                    trans_pct = 100.0 * trans / frame_size\n                    frames_trans.append(trans_pct)\n                \n                # Look for frames with 40-80% transparency (typical for character sprites)\n                if all(40 &lt;= t &lt;= 80 for t in frames_trans):\n                    # Check variance - frames should have similar transparency\n                    variance = max(frames_trans) - min(frames_trans)\n                    if variance &lt; 15:\n                        candidates.append((start, width, height, frames_trans, variance))\n    \n    # Sort by variance (lower is better)\n    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[4])\n    \n    print(f\"Found {len(candidates)} candidates\")\n    \n    # Extract top 10 candidates\n    for i, (start, w, h, trans, var) in enumerate(candidates[:10]):\n        print(f\"  #{i+1}: offset=0x{start:05X}, {w}x{h}, trans=[{trans[0]:.1f}, {trans[1]:.1f}, {trans[2]:.1f}], var={var:.1f}\")\n        \n        frame_size = w * h\n        for j in range(3):\n            frame_start = start + j * frame_size\n            frame_data = decompressed[frame_start:frame_start + frame_size]\n            \n            img = Image.new('P', (w, h))\n            img.putpalette(palette)\n            img.putdata(list(frame_data))\n            img.save(f\"output_brick_search/cand{i+1}_{w}x{h}_frame{j}.png\")\n    \n    # Also extract first few KB as one big image to see layout\n    dump_w, dump_h = 256, 256\n    if len(decompressed) &gt;= dump_w * dump_h:\n        img = Image.new('P', (dump_w, dump_h))\n        img.putpalette(palette)\n        img.putdata(list(decompressed[:dump_w * dump_h]))\n        img.save(\"output_brick_search/first_64k_256x256.png\")\n        print(\"\\nSaved first 64K as 256x256 image\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the decompressed room 3 pair 8 data to understand its structure.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nALFRED1_PATH = \"files/ALFRED.1\"\n\ndef decompress_rle(data, expected_size):\n    result = bytearray()\n    i = 0\n    while i &lt; len(data) and len(result) &lt; expected_size:\n        byte = data[i]\n        i += 1\n        if byte &gt;= 0x80:\n            count = byte - 0x80 + 1\n            if i &lt; len(data):\n                value = data[i]\n                i += 1\n                result.extend([value] * count)\n        else:\n            count = byte + 1\n            result.extend(data[i:i+count])\n            i += count\n    return bytes(result[:expected_size])\n\ndef main():\n    with open(ALFRED1_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        room_dir_offset = 3 * 13 * 8\n        f.seek(room_dir_offset)\n        \n        pairs = []\n        for i in range(13):\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        \n        pair8_offset, pair8_size = pairs[8]\n        f.seek(pair8_offset)\n        compressed = f.read(pair8_size)\n        \n        pair11_offset, pair11_size = pairs[11]\n        f.seek(pair11_offset)\n        pal_data = f.read(pair11_size)\n    \n    decompressed = decompress_rle(compressed, 400000)\n    print(f\"Decompressed size: {len(decompressed)} bytes\")\n    \n    # Analyze byte distribution\n    counter = Counter(decompressed)\n    print(\"\\nTop 20 most common bytes:\")\n    for byte, count in counter.most_common(20):\n        pct = 100.0 * count / len(decompressed)\n        print(f\"  0x{byte:02X} ({byte:3d}): {count:6d} ({pct:5.2f}%)\")\n    \n    # Build palette\n    palette = []\n    for i in range(256):\n        r = pal_data[i*3] * 4\n        g = pal_data[i*3+1] * 4\n        b = pal_data[i*3+2] * 4\n        palette.extend([min(255,r), min(255,g), min(255,b)])\n    \n    os.makedirs(\"output_pair8_analysis\", exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Check palette - what colors are used?\n    print(\"\\nPalette colors for most common bytes:\")\n    for byte, count in counter.most_common(10):\n        r, g, b = palette[byte*3], palette[byte*3+1], palette[byte*3+2]\n        print(f\"  0x{byte:02X}: RGB({r:3d}, {g:3d}, {b:3d})\")\n    \n    # Render at different widths to see if there's a pattern\n    widths_to_try = [40, 44, 48, 60, 71, 72, 80, 100, 320]\n    \n    for width in widths_to_try:\n        height = min(len(decompressed) // width, 400)\n        if height &lt; 10:\n            continue\n        \n        img = Image.new('P', (width, height))\n        img.putpalette(palette)\n        img.putdata(list(decompressed[:width * height]))\n        img.save(f\"output_pair8_analysis/width_{width}.png\")\n        print(f\"Saved width={width} image ({width}x{height})\")\n    \n    # Check if there's structure at specific offsets\n    # From pair 10 analysis, sprites start at various offsets\n    print(\"\\nChecking first 100 bytes as hex:\")\n    print(' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in decompressed[:100]))\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

```
